name: bodypart-fusion-coarse

cpu.note: measured as the cascade bodypart-cascade@r7-fast end to end, which is how this part is served; A5.2.3e, round 1's four blocks pooled (11,081 scored stacks, 32 and 64 workers), cold on the client (the storage server held these blocks): 5.21 h for the 544,972-stack frame. big-1 on the CPU at 32 workers, read third, ran 34.3 a second (4.42 h). Before the overlap A5.3 measured 19.5 a second (ims-a53-bp)
cpu.hardware: 64 cores of an AMD EPYC 9745 host, 256 GB of memory, the archive over NFS 4.2; CPU only; nils-bodypart 0.5.0 (the overlap, its start in the workers), CPU build, torch 2.13.0

limits: New patients, from hospitals and scanners seen in training (round 7: the untouched subjects of iaid, multiple_ms, als, ctrl, broms and nmosd)
A stack without geometry or without a fingerprint gets no answer (an abstention)
Trained on patient pixels: a site model, never exported, never in a release (record 50 study, section 8)
neck against cervical spine follows G2 as Nima ruled on 2026-09-29; the neck class is rare after it
Coarse mode: answers at or above 0.9152 after the coarse calibration, abstains below it (0.92 of stacks on round 8 T)
Arithmetic on the head's six probabilities: runs on the CPU only, and a card changes nothing for it

mode_file.recipe: the head six probabilities at its fine global temperature, summed over the map, then the coarse temperature (per cohort where given, else global)

training_labels.note: the same rows as the registered label set bodypart-gold-r7 that trained_on names, keyed there by DICOM identity

tested.claim: coarse mode on round 8's test T: weighted accuracy and its lower 95 % bound (bar at least 0.93)
coarse mode at 0.9152: weighted error among answered stacks (bar at most 0.02)
coarse mode at 0.9152: weighted coverage (bar at least 0.80)
coarse mode: per-site ECE (bar at most 0.03)
coarse mode minus rules: lower 95 % bound (bar at least -0.02)

intended_use: Propose the coarse body region (head, spine, chest, other) per MR stack from the same model as bodypart-fusion@r7
